announcement.title: Company update — week 3: The engine inspection
announcement.body: The FAA and the engine maker have told airlines to inspect a part on one engine type. Some of Kestrel's aircraft use it. A passenger's video of mechanics working on an engine at the gate is going round on TikTok. Known: the inspections are a precaution and start this week; no Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. Not known: how many aircraft; how long each check takes; whether any part must be replaced.

reading.title: Engine Inspection Mandate
reading.reading: The FAA mandate requires precautionary inspections on some of Kestrel's engines starting this week, which is amplified by a viral TikTok video of gate maintenance. While no actual engine issues have been reported on our fleet, the uncertainty around inspection duration and potential part replacements could lead to minor schedule disruptions. We expect manageable delays and a low rate of cancellations as aircraft are briefly taken out of service for these checks.

effects.cause: Precautionary engine inspections mandated by the FAA
mitigating_actions: lease an aircraft with crew for 2 weeks
free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window
extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks

announcement.title: Company update — week 4
announcement.body: The inspections found worn parts on three Kestrel aircraft. They will stay on the ground for about two weeks while new parts arrive. All other aircraft have been cleared to fly. Kestrel will have to cancel or merge some flights in the next two weeks, Thanksgiving week included.

reading.title: Engine Inspection Update: Three Aircraft Grounded
reading.reading: Three aircraft are grounded for two weeks during the busy Thanksgiving period, representing about 8% of Kestrel's 36-aircraft fleet. While the remaining fleet is cleared, the capacity reduction will force flight cancellations and mergers during Week 4 and Week 5. The airline must manage passenger disruptions and rebookings during a peak travel window.

effects.cause: Three aircraft grounded for engine parts replacement
mitigating_actions: lease an aircraft with crew for 2 weeks
merge low-load flights, announced at least 7 days ahead
rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window
extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause
